scenario: An operations team needs memory and disk usage metrics from EC2 instances. What must they install?

options.note: EC2 doesn't report memory by default.

explanation: Default EC2 metrics include CPU, network and disk I/O for instance store, but not memory.

scenario: Which CloudWatch Logs feature turns matching log events into a metric for alarms?
explanation: For example, count occurrences of 'ERROR' and alarm when it exceeds a threshold.

scenario: An alarm should notify only when both CPU is high AND a health check fails. What should be used?
explanation: Composite alarms reduce alert noise using AND/OR logic.

scenario: Which service can automatically run a Systems Manager Automation runbook when an alarm fires?
explanation: CloudWatch alarms can also trigger Systems Manager actions directly.

scenario: Which service recommends right-sized EC2 instance types and EBS volumes based on usage?

options.text: AWS Config rules for instance types

explanation: Compute Optimizer also covers Lambda, ECS on Fargate and Auto Scaling groups.

scenario: An EBS gp3 volume needs more IOPS without increasing size. What can be done?

options.text: Modify the volume to provision more IOPS
Take a snapshot and restore it to a new volume

explanation: gp3 lets you set IOPS and throughput independently of size.

scenario: Which EC2 placement group gives the lowest network latency between instances for HPC workloads?
explanation: Cluster groups pack instances close together in one AZ.

scenario: Which CloudWatch feature collects metrics and logs from containers in ECS and EKS?
explanation: Container Insights provides CPU, memory, network and restart metrics.

scenario: Which managed service stores and queries Prometheus metrics from Kubernetes clusters?
explanation: Amazon Managed Grafana is commonly used to build dashboards on top of it.

scenario: Which CloudWatch feature runs scripts on a schedule to test a website's availability from outside?

options.text: Metric math expressions on ELB metrics

explanation: Canaries can check APIs, broken links and visual changes.

scenario: An alarm is stuck in INSUFFICIENT_DATA. What's the likely reason?

options.text: The metric isn't receiving data points
The alarm's SNS topic was deleted
The alarm has too many actions configured

explanation: Check that the metric name, dimensions and namespace match.

scenario: Which tool runs commands on many EC2 instances at once without SSH?

options.note: One SSH session at a time.

explanation: Instances need the SSM Agent and an instance profile with SSM permissions.

scenario: Which Systems Manager feature keeps instances in a defined state, such as an agent always installed?
explanation: Associations reapply the desired configuration on a schedule.

scenario: Which Systems Manager feature aggregates operational issues as OpsItems for investigation?
explanation: EventBridge rules and alarms can create OpsItems automatically.

scenario: An RDS database has high read latency due to many reporting queries. What helps without changing the primary?

options.text: Add a read replica for reporting

options.note: Standby is not readable in classic Multi-AZ.

explanation: Point reporting tools to the replica endpoint.

scenario: Which RDS feature shows which SQL queries and waits consume the most database load?
explanation: CloudWatch Database Insights extends Performance Insights with fleet-wide views.

scenario: A CloudWatch Logs group is costing too much. What's the simplest fix?

options.text: Set a retention policy on the log group
Create more metric filters on the group

explanation: Default retention is 'never expire'; export old logs to S3 if needed.

scenario: Which EventBridge capability can react to an EC2 instance state change to 'stopped'?

options.text: A rule matching the EC2 state-change event
A Route 53 health check on the instance

explanation: Targets can be Lambda, SNS, SSM Automation and more.

scenario: Which metric shows if an EC2 burstable (T-family) instance is running out of CPU credits?
explanation: Unlimited mode avoids throttling but can add charges.

scenario: Which EC2 status check failure usually requires stopping and starting the instance to move hosts?
explanation: CloudWatch alarm actions can recover instances automatically.

scenario: An Auto Scaling group should keep average CPU at 50%. Which policy type fits best?
explanation: Target tracking adds and removes capacity to stay near the target.

scenario: Traffic always spikes at 9 AM on weekdays. Which scaling option prepares capacity in advance?

options.text: A larger health check grace period

explanation: Predictive scaling forecasts load from historical patterns.

scenario: An Auto Scaling group must run a script before an instance is terminated. What should be used?
explanation: Lifecycle hooks pause instances in a wait state during launch or termination.

scenario: What does RDS Multi-AZ (single standby) mainly provide?

options.text: More read capacity from the standby

explanation: Multi-AZ DB clusters add readable standbys for some engines.

scenario: Which RDS feature restores a database to any second within the retention period?
explanation: Retention can be set from 1 to 35 days.

scenario: Which service centrally manages backup plans across EBS, RDS, DynamoDB and EFS?
explanation: Backup vaults can be locked to prevent deletion.

scenario: Which Route 53 routing policy sends traffic to a secondary site only when the primary is unhealthy?
explanation: Health checks can monitor endpoints or CloudWatch alarms.

scenario: Which S3 feature protects against accidental overwrites and deletions?
explanation: Add MFA Delete or Object Lock for more protection.

scenario: A company must keep a copy of S3 objects in another Region for disaster recovery. What should be configured?
explanation: Replication requires versioning on both buckets.

scenario: Which ELB setting determines when an unhealthy target stops receiving traffic?
explanation: Auto Scaling can use ELB health checks to replace instances.

scenario: Which disaster recovery strategy has the lowest cost but the longest recovery time?
explanation: Choose based on RTO and RPO requirements.

scenario: Which DR strategy keeps a minimal core (like a replicated database) running and scales up on failover?
explanation: Warm standby runs a scaled-down but functional copy.

scenario: Which DynamoDB feature enables restoring a table to any point in the last 35 days?
explanation: PITR is enabled per table.

scenario: Which DynamoDB feature replicates tables across Regions for multi-Region apps?
explanation: Global tables are multi-active.

scenario: Which EC2 feature can automatically recover an instance on new hardware after a system failure?

options.text: Simplified automatic recovery or a CloudWatch recover action

explanation: The recovered instance keeps its ID, IPs and EBS volumes.

scenario: Which Aurora feature provides fast cross-Region disaster recovery with a secondary cluster?
explanation: Secondary Regions can be promoted in about a minute.

scenario: Which EFS feature reduces costs by moving infrequently used files to cheaper storage?

options.text: Lifecycle management to EFS Infrequent Access

explanation: Intelligent-Tiering can move files back on access.

scenario: Which load balancer feature spreads traffic evenly across targets in all enabled AZs?
explanation: Cross-zone is on by default for ALBs.

scenario: Which ELB setting lets in-flight requests finish before a target is removed?
explanation: The default deregistration delay is 300 seconds.

scenario: Which AWS Backup feature prevents anyone, even root, from deleting recovery points for a set period?
explanation: Governance mode allows privileged users to change settings.

scenario: Which service deploys a CloudFormation stack across many accounts and Regions in one operation?
explanation: StackSets integrate with AWS Organizations for automatic deployment to new accounts.

scenario: Someone changed a security group manually that's managed by CloudFormation. Which feature finds this?
explanation: Drift shows differences between the template and actual resources.

scenario: A stack update failed and rolled back. Where should the operator look for the cause?
explanation: The first failed event usually shows the root cause.

scenario: Which service automates building and patching golden AMIs on a schedule?
explanation: Pipelines can test images and distribute them to other Regions and accounts.

scenario: Which Systems Manager feature schedules OS patching across a fleet using patch baselines?
explanation: Maintenance windows control when patching occurs.

scenario: How can an admin securely connect to a private EC2 instance's shell without opening port 22 or using a bastion?
explanation: Session Manager logs sessions to S3 or CloudWatch Logs.

scenario: Where should application configuration values and secure strings be centrally stored for scripts?
explanation: SecureString parameters are encrypted with KMS.

scenario: Which EC2 feature runs a script automatically at first boot?
explanation: User data runs as root on Linux via cloud-init.

scenario: Which Auto Scaling component defines the AMI, instance type and security groups for new instances?
explanation: Launch templates support versions; launch configurations are legacy.

scenario: Which ECS launch type runs containers without managing EC2 instances?
explanation: Fargate bills per vCPU and memory used by tasks.

scenario: Which service stores and scans container images for an ECS or EKS deployment?
explanation: ECR lifecycle policies remove old images.

scenario: A team needs to share an AMI with another AWS account. What should they do?

options.text: Modify the AMI's launch permissions to add the account
Export the AMI as a file and email it
Copy the EBS volume to S3

explanation: Encrypted AMIs also need the KMS key shared.

scenario: Which feature copies EBS snapshots to another Region for DR automatically on a schedule?
explanation: AWS Backup can also copy backups across Regions.

scenario: Which CloudFormation feature prevents critical resources like a database from being replaced during updates?
explanation: DeletionPolicy: Retain or Snapshot also protects data on stack deletion.

scenario: Which CloudFormation attribute keeps an RDS snapshot when the stack is deleted?
explanation: Retain keeps the resource itself.

scenario: A team wants infrastructure defined in Python that synthesizes to CloudFormation. What should they use?
explanation: Terraform is a popular third-party alternative.

scenario: Which service lets admins share resources like subnets or Transit Gateways across accounts?
explanation: RAM works with AWS Organizations for easy sharing.

scenario: Which Systems Manager feature runs predefined or custom remediation workflows like restarting an instance?
explanation: AWS provides many AWS-* runbooks, like AWS-RestartEC2Instance.

scenario: An ECS service must roll out a new task definition gradually with automatic rollback on failure. What helps?

options.text: The deployment circuit breaker with rolling updates

explanation: Blue/green deployments with CodeDeploy are another option.

scenario: Which feature in AWS Organizations can automatically apply tag policies or backup policies across accounts?
explanation: Management policies include tag, backup, AI opt-out and declarative policies.

scenario: Which service continuously checks resources for compliance and can trigger automatic remediation?

options.text: AWS Config rules with SSM remediation

explanation: Conformance packs bundle many Config rules.

scenario: Which service centralizes findings from GuardDuty, Inspector and Macie with security best-practice checks?
explanation: Security Hub uses standards like AWS Foundational Security Best Practices.

scenario: Which IAM tool identifies resources shared with external accounts and unused permissions?
explanation: Access Analyzer can also validate and generate policies.

scenario: An S3 bucket must deny any request that isn't using HTTPS. What should be added?

options.text: A bucket policy denying aws:SecureTransport false

explanation: This enforces encryption in transit.

scenario: Which CloudTrail feature guarantees log files weren't modified after delivery?
explanation: Digest files are signed so tampering can be detected.

scenario: Which CloudTrail event type records S3 object-level actions like GetObject?
explanation: Data events aren't logged by default and cost extra.

scenario: Which KMS feature lets a key be used by another AWS account?

options.text: A key policy granting that account access
A key alias shared with the account

explanation: The other account's IAM policies must also allow key use.

scenario: Which service manages WAF, Shield Advanced and security group policies across many accounts?
explanation: Firewall Manager requires AWS Organizations.

scenario: Which service scans EC2 instances, ECR images and Lambda functions for vulnerabilities?
explanation: Inspector findings flow into Security Hub.

scenario: Which feature enforces encryption on all new EBS volumes in a Region?
explanation: Existing unencrypted volumes must be copied to encrypt them.

scenario: A team must prevent anyone in member accounts from disabling CloudTrail. What should be used?

options.text: An IAM user policy in each account

explanation: An organization trail also logs all member accounts centrally.

scenario: Which service detects threats such as crypto mining and unusual API activity from logs automatically?
explanation: GuardDuty analyzes CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs and DNS logs.

scenario: Which feature helps prove compliance by collecting evidence for frameworks like PCI DSS?
explanation: Audit Manager maps evidence to controls automatically.

scenario: How can admins require MFA for sensitive API actions like terminating instances?

options.text: A security group rule on the instance

explanation: Conditions can also restrict source IPs and Regions.

scenario: Which service stores secrets with automatic rotation for RDS credentials?
explanation: RDS can also manage master user passwords in Secrets Manager natively.

scenario: Instances in a private subnet need to download OS updates from the internet. What's needed?

options.text: A NAT gateway in a public subnet with a route
An internet gateway route in the private subnet

explanation: Place one NAT gateway per AZ for resilience.

scenario: Which tool captures accepted and rejected IP traffic information for a VPC's network interfaces?
explanation: Flow Logs can be sent to CloudWatch Logs, S3 or Firehose.

scenario: Which tool checks whether a network path exists between two resources and shows the blocking component?
explanation: It analyzes configuration without sending packets.

scenario: An EC2 instance can't receive traffic on port 443 from the internet. The NACL allows it. What else should be checked?

options.text: The instance's security group inbound rules
The EBS volume's KMS key policy

explanation: Also verify the route table has a route to an internet gateway.

scenario: Why might return traffic be blocked even though inbound traffic is allowed by a network ACL?

options.text: NACLs are stateless; outbound ephemeral ports must be allowed

explanation: Allow ephemeral ports (1024–65535) outbound for responses.

scenario: Which service connects many VPCs and on-premises networks through a central hub?
explanation: Transit Gateway supports route tables for segmentation.

scenario: Which option privately exposes a service in one VPC to consumers in other VPCs without peering?

options.text: A NAT instance in each VPC

explanation: Consumers access the service through interface endpoints.

scenario: Which endpoint type lets private subnets reach S3 without a NAT gateway at no hourly cost?

options.note: Hourly cost; also works for S3.

explanation: Gateway endpoints exist for S3 and DynamoDB.

scenario: Which CloudFront feature restricts S3 bucket access so content is only served through CloudFront?
explanation: OAC replaces the older origin access identity (OAI).

scenario: Users report stale content after a website update served by CloudFront. What should be done?

options.text: Create an invalidation for the changed paths

explanation: Versioned file names avoid the need for invalidations.

scenario: Which Route 53 feature resolves on-premises DNS names from inside a VPC?

options.text: Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoints with forwarding rules
Alias records to the DNS servers

explanation: Inbound endpoints let on-premises systems resolve VPC names.

scenario: Which Route 53 record type points a domain apex like example.com to a load balancer?

options.note: Not allowed at the zone apex.

explanation: Alias records are free for queries to AWS resources.

scenario: Which service protects a VPC with stateful inspection and intrusion prevention rules?
explanation: Network Firewall supports Suricata-compatible rules.

scenario: Which service improves global application performance using the AWS backbone and static anycast IPs?
explanation: Global Accelerator also enables fast Regional failover.

scenario: Which connection provides a dedicated private link from a data center to AWS with consistent performance?

options.text: VPC peering to a partner VPC

explanation: Use a VPN over Direct Connect if encryption is required.

scenario: A VPC peering connection is active, but instances can't talk. What's often missing?

options.text: Routes in both VPCs' route tables

explanation: Peering isn't transitive and CIDRs can't overlap.

scenario: Which tool copies network traffic from an ENI to a monitoring appliance for deep inspection?
explanation: Mirrored traffic includes packet payloads.
